protocol.purpose: Train and validate a lightweight whole-portrait quality selector for a genuinely fresh-latent priest generator plus GFPGAN. No finite accepted seed/image bank.
protocol.generator: reference625 raw G psi1 constant noise

development.use: fit only; all attempts preserved, restoration errors cannot pass
development.labels: native visual reviews from three agent reviewers; clear adult male/bareheaded/priest appearance, intact photographic face/head/collar, appealing portrait

protocol.features: frozen official CLIP ViT-B/32 normalized full-frame final decoded WebP embeddings

classifier.other_heads: fixed existing adult/headwear cosine margins recorded as diagnostics, not presumed probabilities

calibration.choice: lowest grid threshold with zero observed false accepts and at least4 accepts; otherwise report pilot failure

test.use: no threshold/model tuning; native review of all attempts with scores hidden; report false accepts and full denominator

protocol.deployment: Readiness is not established by this numerical pilot alone: inspect actual accepted output quality/diversity and measure combined Linux service resource/latency against hosting budget. No production changes in this experiment.

pipeline.preprocess:
Compose(
    Resize(size=224, interpolation=bicubic, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    CenterCrop(size=(224, 224))
    <function _convert_image_to_rgb at 0x113691bc0>
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=(0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073), std=(0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711))
)
